audio_pick.source: companion reel of the carousel, shortlist 2026-10-21

slides.text: Many people feel *a dip after lunch*. It's common.
Don't plan *hard thinking* in that window.
Do your *hardest work* when your mind is clearest.

slides.sub: Follow for one small rule daily

caption:
If your focus fades mid-afternoon, stop forcing it. Move hard work earlier and use the dip for easy tasks.
